parser_notes: GitHub issue reproduction steps for a payout_threshold_cents bug affecting cross-border minimum countries
subject_exact: reported Gumroad bug: cross-border payout threshold not updating when exchange rate drops
snippet_primary: "1. Be a seller in a country with a cross-border minimum > $10 (e.g. Argentina, Colombia, South Korea, Paraguay) 2. Visit Settings → Payments 3. Change any field (e.g. update bank account) and save 4. The country's exchange-rate-dependent minimum is now persisted as your payout_threshold_cents 5. If the exchange rate drops, your threshold stays at the old higher value"
